In various Islamic cultures, Parween has been adopted as a given name for girls born into families that hold dear the significance of nature, beauty, and grace. This name is often associated with the beauty of the natural world and the inclination towards peaceful, pastoral surroundings.

The name Parween draws spiritual significance from the natural world, symbolizing the beauty, calmness, and expansiveness that one might find in a meadow or an open space. It serves as a reminder of the interconnectedness of all creation and the importance of preserving and appreciating the natural world. Additionally, the name Parween can be seen as an embodiment of the ultimate goal of Islam, which is to seek the divine presence of Allah and find peace and tranquility in His creation.
